{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders: status == 'refunded'
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Check if QA orders are also refunded
qa_and_refunded = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"QA orders that are refunded: {len(qa_and_refunded)}")

# Check if QA orders are in the converted group
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]
print(f"QA orders that are converted: {len(qa_converted)}")"}
